description: This file defines the DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer class, which implements the MessageConsumer interface and acts as a wrapper/delegate for a DestinationCommandConsumer, managing device-specific commands in a protocol adapter. It provides methods to close the consumer, manage flow control, and retrieve remaining credit, delegating calls to an underlying supplier-provided consumer.

classes.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
classes.description: A final class that implements MessageConsumer to manage device-specific command consumption in protocol adapters, delegating most actions to an underlying DestinationCommandConsumer supplied via a Supplier.

methods.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the consumer with a supplier of the delegate consumer and the device ID, ensuring neither is null.

methods.name: getDelegate
methods.description: Private method returning the current delegate consumer instance; may return null if the consumer has been closed or is unavailable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the consumer, delegating the operation to the underlying DestinationCommandConsumer if available; otherwise logs and completes with a failed future.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Delegates the flow control credits to the underlying consumer; logs if consumer is unavailable.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the remaining credit from the delegate consumer; returns 0 and logs if delegate is unavailable.
